title: timer

methods.description: set tempo value (float) and time unit (symbol)

body: [timer] measures elapsed logical time: a bang in the left inlet resets it, and a bang in the right inlet outputs the time since then. Logical time moves forward as if all computation were instantaneous and every [delay] and [metro] were exact. Times are in milliseconds by default, which the 'tempo' message or the arguments can change.
